title: Expert Dimension Travel
description: Reworks travel between dimensions to be a little more challenging...
body:
![Demonstration of Nether Portals only being creatable via Ruined Portal structures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Indeterminance/ExpertDimensionTravel/refs/heads/1.20.1/gallery/ruined_portal.png)
# Expert Dimension Travel
Have you ever thought that the Nether is a little too easy to enter? Or maybe that the outer End islands being optional is a little silly? Expert Dimension Travel aims to resolve these by implementing the following changes:

- Nether Portals can only be activated in Ruined Portal structures. Including in the Nether!
- Nether Portals are one-way, and will generate "broken" portals where you come out!
- The central fountain in the End has been changed, with no exit portal generating after the Ender Dragon has been defeated!
- Using an End Gateway to access the outer End islands no longer generates a return gateway at the destination, however...
- ...using an End Gateway in the outer End islands returns you to the Overworld instead of merely teleporting you to the main End island.

Good luck!
